access.title: Board is for teachers
access.text: Sign in with a teacher account to open and control boards in your Spaces.

hero.title: Board
hero.text: Use Board for questions, polls and wordwalls on a big screen while students respond live from their own devices.

video.title: Training video
video.text: This is where we will add a short training video once the board has been tested in a real classroom.

guide.title: How to use the board
guide.step1: 1. Choose the room you are teaching in.
guide.step2: 2. Open the big-screen view and move it to the classroom display.
guide.step3: 3. Start a live activity from the teacher surface when students should participate.

rooms.title: Choose board by room
rooms.text: Open the board for a Space, or quickly see whether a board is already live.
rooms.empty: You do not have any Spaces yet.
